caption: The drawing features a symmetrical floral and botanical motif composed of stylized elements in muted shades of green, maroon, gold, and purple. At the center, there is a large pinecone-like shape created with maroon oval sections, surrounded by alternating green leaf-like forms radiating outward. This central element emerges from a golden and green ornamental vase or basket with vertical stripes and a maroon diamond pattern at the top. On each side of the arrangement, extended maroon branches curve outward. Above the central motif, a pair of green, heart-shaped leaves hang side by side, connected by curving, intertwined gold vines that also encompass small maroon and gold flowers symmetrically placed to the left and right. At the top, a semi-circular maroon flower with radiating petals and a small green stem is flanked by two similarly colored smaller flowers. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: San Gabriel Mission Priest's Vestment from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
